body_markdown:
DOWNERS GROVE, Ill.


, Nov. 3, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Dover Corporation (NYSE:DOV ) announced that its President and Chief Executive Officer, Richard J. Tobin, will speak at the Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference in Chicago, Illinois, on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 9:40 am CT.


A link to the live audio webcast of the presentation will be available on[dovercorporation.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813191-1&h=511865165&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.dovercorporation.com%2F&a=dovercorporation.com) , and the replay will be archived on the website for 90 days.


**About Dover:**


Dover is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider with annual revenue of over $8 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments: Engineered Products, Clean Energy & Fueling, Imaging & Identification, Pumps & Process Solutions and Climate & Sustainability Technologies. Dover combines global scale with operational agility to lead the markets we serve. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 70 years, our team of approximately 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible. Headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois, Dover trades on the New York Stock Exchange under "DOV." Additional information is available at[dovercorporation.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813191-1&h=511865165&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.dovercorporation.com%2F&a=dovercorporation.com) .
